about.message: Moves files after download into other locations.
about.description: Short description of the Easy Sort extension shown in settings.

description.message:
This script moves files with specified extensions into another directory.
It offers flexible organization options:

- Flat Mode: Files are moved into the specified `DestDir` directory.
- Parent Directory Mode: Files are moved into the parent directory using `DestDir=..` (flattening).
- Category Subdirectory Mode:  Files are organized into subdirectories within `DestDir` based on the category using `UseCategoryDir`.
- NZB Parent Subdirectory Mode: Files are organized into subdirectories within `DestDir` based on the NZB filename using `UseNzbParentDir`

You can combine `UseCategoryDir` and `UseNzbParentDir` for further organization.

Additionally, there is an option to delete the source directory with all remaining files.
description.description: Full description of the extension shown in settings.

requirements.message: This script requires Python 3.8+ to be installed on your system.
requirements.description: System requirements (each requirement is a separate string). DO NOT translate technical version strings (e.g., Python 3.8.x).

destdir_desc.message:
Destination directory to move all files into.

Set to ".." to move into parent directory (flatten mode).
destdir_desc.description: Help text for the DestDir option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate technical or example values enclosed in quotes.

usecategorydir_desc.message:
Create subdirectory in <DestDir> based on category-name.

If you use <AppendCategoryDir> you will probably also want this option enabled.

NOTE: It only works with Category*.Name and not Category*.DestDir.
usecategorydir_desc.description: Help text for the UseCategoryDir option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate option names enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <MinSize>, <TvCategories>). DO NOT translate the exact uppercase label (NOTE) as they are used to render UI badges.

usenzbparentdir_desc.message:
Create subdirectory for each nzb-file.

You can combine this option with <UseCategoryDir>.

NOTE: Disabling this option may cause losing data based on your clean-up settings.
Example: All files in the folder from multiple nzb sources are deleted on import.
usenzbparentdir_desc.description: Help text for the UseNzbParentDir option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate option names enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <MinSize>, <TvCategories>). DO NOT translate the exact uppercase label (NOTE) as they are used to render UI badges.

extensions_desc.message:
File extensions to process.

Only files with these extensions are processed. Extensions must
be separated with commas.

Example=.mkv,.avi,.divx

If the list of extensions is empty all files are processed.
extensions_desc.description: Help text for the Extensions option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate the example value after 'Example='.

minsize_desc.message:
Minimum file size (Kilobytes).

Smaller files are ignored.
Use "0" for including all files.
minsize_desc.description: Help text for the MinSize option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate technical or example values enclosed in quotes.

overwrite_desc.message:
Overwrite files at destination.

If not active the files are still moved into destination but
unique suffixes are added at the end of file names, e.g. My.File.(2).mkv.
overwrite_desc.description: Help text for the Overwrite option in Easy Sort.

cleanup_desc.message:
Delete download directory after renaming.

Delete download directory after processing. If no files could be processed,
the directory remains untouched.
cleanup_desc.description: Help text for the Cleanup option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'.

preview_desc.message:
Preview mode.

When active no changes to file system are made but the destination
file names are logged. Useful for debugging.
preview_desc.description: Help text for the Preview option in Easy Sort. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'.

verbose_desc.message:
Print more logging messages.

For debugging or if you need to report a bug.
verbose_desc.description: Help text for the Verbose option in Easy Sort.
